name: CM39_one_program
origins: user requirement 2026-10-21 (one software, one working module; document all work so nothing interferes)
statement: Parallel work lands as one program: law numbers and goal ids are unique and allocated in docs/INTEGRATION.md, every law is carried by a capability, every command is in the CLI help, every verify section and doc is described, generated docs are in sync and no merge markers remain; a branch is merged into main only when the tests, verify and this integrity check pass, and every integration is logged.
